description_en: Queries the preview data of a scene model based on a preview token
description_zh: 根据预览token查询场景模型预览数据
name: GetHotspotSceneData

parameters.help_en: The type. Valid values: 0: Unpublished. 1: Published
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The custom OSS domain name. You can also specify a CDN domain name
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable access to self-owned resources
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自用资源访问
parameters.name: enabled

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authorization diagnostic details returned when a permission check fails. The details include the principal, action, policy, and denial cause
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authorization action that triggered the permission denied error. You can use this action to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The type of the principal, such as RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An authorized account administrator can decode the message to troubleshoot the denial cause
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the permission denial cause, which distinguishes between implicit deny and explicit deny
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the permission denied error, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

PreviewData.description_en: The HTML-converted preview data, which includes information such as images and sub-scene IDs
PreviewData.description_zh: html转译后的预览数据，包含图片、子场景ID等信息
PreviewData.title_en: html转译后的预览数据，包含图片、子场景ID等信息
PreviewData.title_zh: html转译后的预览数据，包含图片、子场景ID等信息

SceneType.description_en: The scene type. Valid values: MODEL_3D: 3D model. PIC: Panoramic image. VIDEO: Panoramic video
SceneType.description_zh: 3D模型：MODEL_3D 全景图片：PIC 全景视频：VIDEO
SceneType.title_en: 3D模型：MODEL_3D 全景图片：PIC 全景视频：VIDEO
SceneType.title_zh: 3D模型：MODEL_3D 全景图片：PIC 全景视频：VIDEO

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
